model.coverageLabel: Source-linked full-credit curriculum with proposed approved-course choices; transfer matches require separate evidence.
rulesNotes: A 120-credit zero-technology-assessment scenario: 37 unique general-education credits + 9 major-foundation credits + 60 major-course credits + 14 free-elective credits.
The published resident sequence uses ECON 213 as social science; its 3 credits are counted once.
Technology competency is printed as 0–3 credits. The zero-credit scenario requires passing the university assessment; otherwise adjust elective allocation.
The residential major uses ACCT 350 and BUSI 490, not the online ACCT 340/BUSI 400 pair.
RLGN 105/EVAN 101 waivers at 45 transfer credits and THEO 201/THEO 202 waivers at 60 require individual evaluation; no automatic removal occurs.

unresolved.message: Confirm that your admission and enrollment history entitles you to the 2026–2027 catalog, and send official records for Liberty’s individual degree audit.
Check course-specific prerequisites and outside-course recommendation versions where current evidence has not yet been recorded.
The published 25% major-residency fraction is enforced against this model’s reviewed 69-credit major ledger; individual transfer awards remain separate.

unresolved: Outside-course equivalencies must be sourced separately; a university requirement is not evidence that a particular accelerated course transfers.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in the requirements under the catalog major section, including its listed foundations and other named major sections.
gradePolicy.scopeNote: The catalog says all courses in the major and places foundations and major courses under Major Requirements; confirm individual evaluation of foundations with Liberty.

exclusions: Fees, housing, meals, books, supplies and course-specific charges are separate.
The full-time band applies to fall and spring semesters. Summer uses a separate per-credit rate.
Loads above 18 credits are outside this reviewed band; no overload charge is inferred.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of the published degree-credit total must be completed through Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total minus the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall ceiling only; exact course applicability, major/minor residency and source-specific policies remain separate.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: Published fraction; the denominator is the exact degree major/minor ledger, not the whole degree.
